title: Donate to Toynbee Hall
intro: Your donation helps people access advice, support and community activities, and contributes to a fairer future for East London.

blocks.heading: Your support matters
paragraphs: Donations help Toynbee Hall work alongside people facing poverty and injustice. Choose a donation option through the charity’s secure giving service.

blocks.heading: Other ways to help
paragraphs: You can also fundraise, volunteer or explore a corporate partnership.
